title: "6" + "4" is 10: + converts both text operands to numbers

source.quote: Any argument passed as a string to the binary operator is automatically converted into a number
source.supports: the page says 6 + 4 and "6" + "4" return the same result

derivation: Both strings are converted to numbers, 6 and 4, and 6 + 4 = 10.
notes: The column's type is not asserted: no source says which numeric type the text becomes.
